title: Emacs Essay and HN Thread Debate an LLM-Free Fork
summary: A new essay, “Emacs in the Age of Magic,” and its Hacker News thread are debating an LLM-free Emacs fork. Commenters quote a declaration of intent to use and develop an LLM-free Emacs regardless of GNU policy, pointing to human-emacs.org. That declaration is a stated plan, not a shipped fork; the supplied material reports no code release, version, or GNU policy change.

references.title: Emacs group vows fork if project accepts LLM-generated code
